opening.argument: The presentation shows a trading dashboard with coin positions, profit and loss, filled orders, and a control to halt trading, alongside settings for lot size and maximum lots. It also discusses connecting the trader to a cryptocurrency account, placing the financial claims within a software demonstration and trading masterclass. The presenter gives a conditional projection based on starting with $500 and contributing $500 monthly, while also stating that the presenters are not financial investment advisors. A discounted license is offered, but the demonstration, instructional material, and stated disclaimer support reading the purchase discussion as part of a hosted presentation rather than proof of deceptive conduct.
